## Saved queries (1)

- `monthly_rev`

SQL:
SELECT
  customers__cities.size_class AS "orders.customers.cities.size_class",
  CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.amount_sum",
  COUNT(*) AS "orders._count"
FROM orders AS orders
LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
  ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
LEFT JOIN cities AS customers__cities
  ON customers.city = customers__cities.city
  AND customers.region_id = customers__cities.region_id
GROUP BY
  customers__cities.size_class
LIMIT 21
